request.noItems: Nothing to share in this category.

ai.title: AI assistance
ai.subtitle: Optional. It organises what you wrote and translates it for your doctor — it does not diagnose.
ai.consentBody: CareBridge can detect the language you wrote in, translate it into English for your doctor, and pull out items such as symptoms, durations and medicines. Your original words are always kept, and nothing is added to your health record until you confirm it.
ai.consentExternalNote: When an external AI provider is configured, your text is sent to that provider for processing.
ai.consentRequired: Turn on AI processing to use this.
ai.reviewSubtitle: Nothing is added to your health record until you confirm it.
ai.noFacts: The AI did not find anything it could support with your own words.

docAi.title: Read this document
docAi.subtitle: Optional. CareBridge reads the text on each page and lists items for you to check. It does not interpret results or diagnose.
docAi.originalStays: Your original file is never changed. It stays available above, exactly as you uploaded it.
docAi.consentBody: Reading a document uses AI processing. The text on each page is read, translated into English where needed, and items such as medicines, allergies and measurements are listed for you to check. Nothing is added to your health record until you confirm it.
docAi.notRead: This document has not been read yet.
docAi.failed: This document could not be read. The original file is unchanged and still available.
docAi.noText: No text could be found in this document.
docAi.pageAi: AI could not process this page. The text read from it is shown above.
docAi.noItems: No items on this page could be supported by its text.
docAi.reviewSubtitle: Confirm, correct or reject each item. Nothing is added to your health record until you confirm it.
